title: Developer API console still lists the three retired /api/v1/ai/assistant routes as try-it rows; they answer 404 since cloud#2621
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect (a dead console entry), from a measured runtime change. Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat (`repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01Wxo1xhh2bU66T73q23jzE4`, R44), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2621 os-dev report 6011436878 (`out_of_scope_findings` 1). Reader: the objectui lane (`domain:ui`), for grading and dispatch. ⛔ No state set by this seat: the grade and queue are that lane's.

## What changed on the server

The maintainer ruled A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2621 (triage ruling 6010663551) to retire the three `/api/v1/ai/assistant` routes:
- `GET /assistant`
- `GET /assistant/skills`
- `POST /assistant/chat`

PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2651 removes them. Measured on the hosted composition after that PR: each answers `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` to an admin, a member and anonymous, the same as a path that was never mounted. The agent route (`POST /api/v1/ai/agents/:agentName/chat`) is the one chat door.

## What the console still shows

The developer API console lists the three routes as hand-written try-it rows. They are not served from a route listing.
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/hooks/useApiDiscovery.ts:115-117`: the three rows, in the static `ai` group whose `defaultRoute` is `/api/v1/ai`;
- `:113-114`: the "Ambient assistant" comment;
- `:79-81`: a comment that counts four conditionally mounted builders, `/assistant/*` among them. Three remain.

This was read at objectui `c476be0` (cloud's `.objectui-sha`) and is unchanged on objectui `main` `c3623eb1`.

## The step

Remove the three rows and correct the two comments. No other caller of these paths exists in objectui (`git grep "ai/assistant"` = 0 code hits at `c476be0`).

Cloud's `ai-route-ledger.ts` docblock names this exact difference: "the console listed a route that 404s here" versus "the console listed a route that does not exist".
